text:
maria: Quick check — thinking about regrouping the left nav into three top clusters (Workloads, Models, Platform). Main goals: reduce click depth, improve task scent, and make deep links stable across workspaces. Thoughts?
eli: I like the three clusters idea but worried about mixed affordance: Models vs Workloads have different mental models. Could we keep a small separator and slightly different iconography? :thinking:
samir: Accessibility nit — if we collapse items under cluster headings, ensure headings are semantic <button aria-expanded> and that keyboard focus lands on first visible item. Also breadcrumbs need good ARIA labeling.
aisha: Copy tweak: instead of "Workloads" maybe "Apps & Jobs" for clarity for non-ML users. Deep-linking: when you land on a nested route (e.g., /models/x/versions) we should highlight the cluster and the exact leaf, not the intermediate hub only.
maria: Good call on copy. I like "Apps & Jobs". For deep links, proposal: canonicalize URL fragment to include cluster slug + leaf id so routing is deterministic across workspace contexts. Example: /workspace/:ws/cluster:models/asset/:id -> fallback to /cluster/models if permission missing.
eli: Small UX flow concern: if we canonicalize cluster in the URL, switching workspace should prompt/redirect? Might be surprising. Maybe we silently map to equivalent resource in new workspace when ids exist, otherwise show an inline toast: "Resource not available in this workspace — showing Models hub."
samir: +1 on toast. Also show skip link at top: "Skip to content" which should land in the main content region for screen reader users. Breadcrumbs should include cluster > section > item with proper separators and role=navigation.
aisha: For the sidebar, suggestion: add a compact chevron behavior (hover to expand) for large workspaces so users can scan clusters faster. But make sure hover-expansion is optional (pref in settings) — hover-only expansion is not keyboard-friendly.
design-bot: [autotests] nav-deeplink-regression: failed on /models/abc -> highlighting mismatch (expected Models > abc, got Platform > abc). CI: https://ci/redwood/2451
maria: Thanks bot. Eli — can you pick up the highlight mismatch? Samir, can you audit the ARIA roles on the collapsed cluster prototype? Aisha, can you write two copy options for user research: "Workloads" vs "Apps & Jobs" and prepare a quick poll in the console? I'll coordinate a quick 20-min sync tomorrow.
eli: On it. I’ll also add a small unit test verifying: when landing on /workspace/:ws/cluster/models/asset/:id the sidebar highlights cluster=models and leaf=asset/:id.
samir: Will run the ARIA checklist against the prototype today.
aisha: I'll draft the poll and ping design-research. Draft copy: Option A — "Workloads" (short, familiar to ML teams). Option B — "Apps & Jobs" (broader to product/platform teams).
maria: Perfect. Sync tomorrow 10:15 PT. Agenda: 1) fix highlight bug 2) ARIA audit findings 3) copy poll results 4) hover-expansion setting decision. :calendar: 
eli: See you then. :+1:
